# OpenAI Codex notices

The root server image installs the unmodified official `@openai/codex@0.165.0`
package. LICENSE and NOTICE are preserved from
https://github.com/openai/codex/tree/rust-v0.165.0.
Codex is a separate component under Apache-2.0; the FBR distribution does not
claim authorship or endorsement. The application build includes these notices
in its third-party notices as well as at `/usr/local/share/licenses/codex` in
the server image. Update the package version and notices together.
